interval_take: The week that Dhurandhar 2's stranglehold on the market finally meets its first real challenger. Bhooth Bangla previews begin tonight at 9 PM — the first major new Hindi release in four weeks. Akshay Kumar, Priyadarshan, and the Bhool Bhulaiyaa ensemble arrive with a ₹120 crore budget and a break-even ceiling of ₹184 crore. Boxoffy's four-technique model calls D1 at ₹15.8 crore. Meanwhile, D2's BOI canonical total sits at approximately ₹983 crore through Day 26. Our April 17 (D30) call for BOI canonical ₹1,000 crore certification is now within ₹17 crore — live tracking in the dashboard. Dacoit told its story in four days. The Monday number (₹2.70 crore) after a ₹6.55 crore opening is a Flop trajectory on a ₹60-80 crore budget — it needed sustained WOM and got none. Bhooth Bangla's first weekend will determine whether the post-D2 market has genuinely re-opened or whether audience appetite has been reset to a higher bar.

interval_take: The week that Hindi cinema makes history — twice over. Dhurandhar: The Revenge crossed ₹1,000 crore net in Hindi alone on Day 24 (April 11, Saturday) — the first film in any single language ever to do so at the Indian box office. Sacnilk all-language cumulative through D23 stands at ₹1,055 crore. Boxoffy BOI canonical model puts the total at ~₹963 crore through D23, applying the confirmed 0.903 calibration ratio — our April 17 (D30) call for BOI canonical ₹1,000 crore remains live. Dacoit opened to ₹6.55 crore on D1 — career best for Adivi Sesh, but the film needs a strong weekend to justify its ₹60-80 crore budget. Telugu-heavy opening (₹5.45 Cr) with ₹1.1 Cr from Hindi. The trade verdict arrives Sunday evening. Bhooth Bangla previews begin Thursday April 16 — the real screen war starts then.

interval_take: D12 Monday came in at ₹25.30 Cr — a natural dip as IPL 2026 began and the second weekday cycle settled. D0–D12 India nett stands at ₹867 Cr on BOI basis (Sacnilk calculates ₹872 Cr using D5 ₹65 Cr — Boxoffy takes BOI's ₹60 Cr). KGF Chapter 2's India lifetime (₹859.7 Cr nett) has been passed. ₹1,000 Cr nett is the next milestone — at D8-D12 averaging ₹49.5 Cr/day, the film needs 3–4 more strong days. WW stands at ~₹1,392 Cr. NA has already broken Baahubali 2's all-time Indian film record at $23M+. D2 is now the #2 Hindi film of all time in India nett behind Pathaan (₹543 Cr? No) — actually #1 Hindi film of all time.
nextWeek: D13 Tue + D14 Wed key — ₹1,000 Cr India nett target by Thu Apr 2. IPL headwind manageable on weekdays. D2 eyes Pathaan overseas record. No new major Hindi competition until mid-April.

interval_take: Boxoffy correction issued. After cross-referencing BOI and Pinkvilla against Sacnilk, Sacnilk Hindi figures appear inflated — particularly D1 where Sacnilk reports ₹99.1 Cr vs BOI ₹75 Cr and Pinkvilla ₹73 Cr, a 33% gap. Pinkvilla and BOI align closely throughout. Revised canonical: BOI Hindi D0-D7 ₹532 Cr + other languages ~₹30 Cr = ~₹562 Cr India nett. WW ₹1,006.50 Cr is not disputed — Sacnilk WW uses confirmed distributor data. BLOCKBUSTER verdict and all records unchanged — D2 is still historic at any number.
